en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Tumaco
en.summary: A priest is said to have calmed an advancing tsunami by raising the Blessed Sacrament over the sea.
en.body: As a tsunami wave approached Tumaco on the Colombian coast in January 1906, the parish priest carried the Blessed Sacrament to the shore and raised it toward the advancing water. Witnesses reported that the wave slowed and receded, and local tradition credits the town's survival to the gesture.
